title: The Janitor Who Secretly Died With $8 Million
description:
Ronald Read worked as a gas station attendant and a janitor, lived frugally, and quietly built an almost $8 million fortune with boring dividend stocks he held for decades. The lesson: time beats salary.

Educational content, not financial advice. Narration and visuals are AI-assisted.
